config:
[server]
auth_mode = "required"
api_keys = ["client-secret"]
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"
aliases = ["m-a-alias"]

[[models]]
name = "m-b"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
metadata = { n = 9007199254740993, label = "b" }
name: m4_static_models_order_metadata
